children: The project, which is being driven by Water Industry National Environment Programme (WINEP) requirements, will involve the creation of a 23km cross-country pipeline that conveys flows from the Packington and Measham treatment works.
Chief executive Bill Hocking said: "We are delighted to be strengthening our long-standing relationship with Severn Trent with a project of this scale and significance.

"Delivering the River Mease Improvement project reinforces our position as a leading delivery partner for complex, large-scale water and wastewater infrastructure projects that support environmental compliance and long-term resilience."
